source.title: Blue Espresso Machine Print | Coffee Bar Wall Art | Kitchen Decor Poster

analysis.summary: A whimsical watercolor illustration of a bright blue espresso machine with a tiny cup and hand-lettered text requesting an extra shot.
analysis.subject: A retro-style blue espresso machine
analysis.action: Preparing a single cup of espresso
analysis.style: Loose watercolor and gouache illustration, naive sketching, visible brush strokes, and soft color bleeding on textured paper
analysis.composition: Vertical portrait, centered subject in the lower two-thirds, text floating in the upper third, significant negative space
analysis.typography: "Extra shot please." in a handwritten, casual blue script
analysis.audience: Millennial homeowners and coffee enthusiasts looking for kitchen or cafe-nook decor
analysis.hook: It combines a relatable morning craving with a perfectly imperfect hand-painted aesthetic that feels personal and artisanal rather than mass-produced.

outputs.title: French Press Morning
outputs.brief: Paint a vibrant mustard-yellow French press next to a half-full mug of dark coffee on a light-grained wooden table. Use a high-angle perspective looking down at the objects to create a cozy breakfast scene. The style should be loose gouache with visible brush marks and slight paint spatters for a lived-in feel. The palette includes ochre, espresso brown, warm cream, and sage green for a small leaf accent. Include hand-lettered text at the bottom reading 'Just one more' in a casual, thick brush script.

outputs.title: Botanical Bean Ritual
outputs.brief: Create a minimalist, mid-century modern illustration featuring a simplified branch of a coffee plant with round red berries and white blossoms. The branch is set inside a translucent, geometric carafe outline positioned in the center of the frame. Use a risograph texture with grainy overlays and slightly misaligned color blocks for an artisanal print look. The palette focuses on terracotta, sage green, toasted almond, and soft apricot against a plain cream background. This composition contains no text, focusing entirely on clean graphic shapes.
